## Calendar Heat Map

*August 10, 2026*

Deneb/Vega-Lite can be used to present a ***Calendar Heat Map*** to display aggregated data by day-of-month, month, and quarter. While such a visual was released publically almost 4 years ago on the *Deneb Showcase* section of the *Enterprise DNA Support Forum* (now retired), the updated version presented here has additional features, including:
- user-selectable display language (English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Polish, and Dutch)
- user-selectable week starting day (Sunday or Monday)
- user-selectable daily metric (Count or Value)

Each is presented as a standard single-select native Power BI slicer.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/143ecc96-3d37-461b-9619-e627a622d6ed

The visual uses:
- a double-facetted display, with calendar quarters on rows and calendar quarter months on rows
- a rounded-rectangle using a gradient colour scheme to indicate the size of the daily metric in a continuous linear order (in this case, smaller values lighter and larger value darker)
- a full-width gradient legend

Additionally, standard ***Power BI sentence tooltips*** are implemented sending 5 fields from the Deneb visual to Power BI and the following sentence template:

``` json
{_day_of_month_number} {_month_name} {_year}: {_daily_metric} ({_daily_metric_percent})
```

> [!NOTE]
> *This template uses the culture of the container, so it can be used as-is in a browser with only a minor change to the dataset, namely using a simple DAX measure. (When a language other than those mentioned above are used, the display will default to English.)*


``` json
Culture = USERCULTURE()
```

To implement a user-selectable week starting date, this solution uses internal Vega-Lite calculations for Sunday starts and ISO-calculated fields in Melissa de Korte's *Extended Date Table* for Monday starts; the M code for Melissa's date table can be found here:
<br>
https://gist.github.com/m-dekorte/12b53faee9cc1a616fa23f15b1b4a173

I provide 2 Deneb templates for this scenario: 1 that renders ***Multiple Languages*** and 1 that renders a ***Single Language*** (French). While the code is very similar in both, the code for the more extensive ***Multiple Languages*** version is presented here and illustrates a number of Deneb/Vega-Lite features, including:

<br>

0 - General:
- a dynamic ***title*** block with:
    - ***direct data access*** to determine the language and display the ***title*** appropriately
    - ***direct data access*** to determine the both the language and metric and display the ***subtitle*** appropriately
- a standard Power BI dataset
- a shared ***transform*** block with:
    - 7x ***calculate*** transforms to assign internal names to the Power BI dataset fields
    - 7x ***calculate*** transforms to determine the date components of the dataset (year, quarter, month, week, day-of-year, day-of-month, day-of-week)
    - a ***calculate*** transform to update the ISO week-of-year number to set values if December and week 1 to week 53 to permit correct display of ISO weeks
    - a ***calculate*** transform to determine the correct week-of-year option based on the user-selected day-of-week starting day
    - a ***window/rank*** transform to determine the week-of-month number from the week-of-year number
    - a ***calculate*** transform to compose the quarter display name from the language-dependent quarter prefix, number, and suffix (see the ***params*** block below)
    - a ***calculate*** transform to determine the month-of-quarter number
    - a ***calculate*** transform to extract the language-dependent month name from the month name array (again, see the ***params*** block below)
    - a ***calculate*** transform to extract the language-dependent weekday initials name from the weekday initials array (again, see the ***params*** block below)
    - a ***calculate*** transform to compose a composite label for the X-axis for the day-of-week number and initials
    - a ***calculate*** transform to determine the correct daily metric number base on the user-selectable metric choice
    - ***joinaggregate/min***and ***joinaggregate/max*** transforms to determine the ***min*** and ***max*** daily metric numbers
    - a ***calculate*** transform to determine the daily metric number as a % of the max daily metric number
- a shared ***params*** block with:
    - an ***expr*** parameter using ***direct data access*** to extract the 2-character language from the 5-character culture
    - 2x ***expr*** parameters that use the 2-character language to set the quarter prefix and suffix
    - 7x ***expr*** parameters to set a month name array for each language option
    - 7x ***expr*** parameters to set a 2-character weekday name array for each language option
    - 2x ***expr*** parameters to determine the month name array and 2-character weekday name array using the 2-character language
    - an ***expr*** parameter using ***direct data access*** to retrieve the user-selected metric
- a ***facet*** block with:
    - rows: quarters with ***padding*** set to adjust the space between the row label and the chart
    - columns: month-of-quarter with ***header font size*** set to zero to prevent automatic header display

1 - Heat Map:
- a ***vconcat*** block for the month header and the month calendar

1a - Month Header:
- a nested ***transform*** block with:
    - a ***filter*** transform to restrict the dataset to a single record per month
- a ***text*** mark with:
    - a ***named style***

1b - Month Calendar:
- a nested ***encoding*** block with:
    - X-axis: the composite label for the day-of-week number and initials
    - Y-axis: the week-of-month number
    - Tooltip: the full set of fields that will be provided to and referenced by the ***Power BI sentence tooltip***
    - a ***layer*** block for the daily rectangle, and the day-of-month text
 
1b1 - Daily Rectangle:
- a nested ***params*** block with:
    - a ***pointerover*** parameter to capture the day-of-year number that the mouse is hovering over (with the ***resolve*** key set to ***global*** to make the parameter visible to all layered marks)
- a ***rect*** mark with:
    - identical ***width*** and ***height*** to render as a square
    - tooltip = ***true*** to provide the calendar tooltip to the ***Power BI tooltip handler***
    - a ***named style***
    - a nested ***encoding*** block with:
        - a ***fill*** colour gradient with:
            - a ***scale/range*** block using the darkest and lightest of the ***Power Bi theme colours***
            - a standard Vega-Lite ***gradient legend*** with specified width and tick count
        - ***conditional stroke colour*** (using the ***pointerover*** parameter to change colour when the mouse is hovering)
        - ***conditional stroke width*** (using the ***pointerover*** parameter to change width when the mouse is hovering)

1b2 - Day-of-Month Label:
- a nested ***transform*** block with:
    - a ***calculate*** transform to assign the day-of-year number from the ***pointerover*** parameter to an internal field
- a ***text*** mark with:
    - ***conditional font size*** (using the ***pointerover*** parameter to change colour when the mouse is hovering)
    - ***conditional colour*** (if the daily metric number as a % of the max daily metric number is less than 40% then black else white)
    - tooltip = ***true*** to provide the calendar tooltip to the ***Power BI tooltip handler***

2 - Config:
- configuration values set for:
    - border colour ([stroke] set to transparent)
    - title font attributes (family, size, weight, style, colour)
    - subtitle font attributes (family, size, weight, style, colour)
    - legend font attributes (family, size,  colour)
    - facet header font attributes (size, weight, style, colour)
    - X axis settings for title (off), ticks, grid, domain, and labels (ticks off, grid off, domain colour, label font family, size, weight, style, colour)
- named styles:
    - month name text (family, size, weight, style, colour)
    - day number text (family, weight, style)
    - daily rectangle (corner rounding, identical ***width*** and ***height*** to ensure the rectangle render as a square, alignment, default stroke colour and width)

  /*

    "title": "Deneb Calendar Heat Map (Multiple Languages)",
    "author": "Greg Philps",

    "power bi desktop version": "2.156.951.0",
    "description": "A heat map matrix of daily performance in a calendar layout (quarter months horizontally, quarters vertically)",
    "notes": "language selection via slicer; week start date via slicer; daily metric selection via slicer",
    "template notes": "usermeta object is used by the Deneb template generation process and is thus overwritten, hence added here as a comment"
  },
  */
  "title": {
    "anchor": "start",
    "align": "left",
    "offset": 16,
    // static title
    // "text": "Deneb Calendar Heat Map",
    // dynamic title
    "text": {
      "expr": "slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'en' ? 'Deneb Calendar Heat Map' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'fr' ? 'Carte thermique du calendrier Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'es' ? 'Mapa de calor del calendario de Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'de' ? 'Deneb Kalender-Heatmap' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'it' ? 'Mappa di calore del calendario Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'pl' ? 'Mapa cieplna kalendarza Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'nl' ? 'Deneb Kalender Heatmap' : 'unknown' "
    },
    // static subtitle
    // "subtitle": "Transaction count by day by week by month by quarter"
    // dynamic subtitle
    "subtitle": {
      "expr": "slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'en' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Transaction count by day by week by month by quarter' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'en' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Sales value by day by week by month by quarter' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'fr' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Nombre de transactions par jour, par semaine, par mois, et par trimestre' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'fr' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Valeur des ventes par jour, par semaine, par mois, et par trimestre' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'es' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Número de transacciones por día, por semana, por mes, y por trimestre' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'es' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Valor de las ventas por día, por semana, por mes, y por trimestre' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'de' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Transaktionsanzahl pro Tag, Woche, Monat, und Quartal' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'de' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Umsatz pro Tag, Woche, Monat, und Quartal' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'it' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Numero di transazioni per giorno, per settimana, per mese e per trimestre' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'it' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Valore delle vendite per giorno, per settimana, per mese e per trimestre' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'pl' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Liczba transakcji według dnia, tygodnia, miesiąca i kwartału' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'pl' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Wartość sprzedaży według dnia, tygodnia, miesiąca i kwartału' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'nl' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ? 'Aantal transacties per dag, per week, per maand, per kwartaal' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'nl' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Value' ? 'Verkoopwaarde per dag, per week, per maand, per kwartaal' : 'unknown' "
    }
  },
  // standard Power BI dataset
  "data": {
    "name": "dataset"
  },
  "transform": [
    // assign dev id to help identify dataset in data pane
    {
      "calculate": "1",
      "as": "_DEV_ID"
    },
    // assign internal names to dataset fields
    {
      "calculate": "datum['__0__']",
      "as": "_date"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "datum['__2__']",
      "as": "_iso_day_of_week_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "datum['__3__']",
      "as": "_iso_week_of_year_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "datum['__7__']",
      "as": "_daily_transactions"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "datum['__8__']",
      "as": "_daily_value"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "lower( datum['__5__'] )",
      "as": "_week_start_day"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "lower( datum['__6__'] )",
      "as": "_metric"
    },
    // calculate date components
    {
      "calculate": "year( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_year"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "quarter( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_quarter_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "month( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_month_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "week( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_week_of_year_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "dayofyear( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_day_of_year_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "date( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_day_of_month_number"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "day( datum['_date'] )",
      "as": "_day_of_week_number"
    },
    // check for 53rd Week Number
    {
      "calculate": "if( datum['_month_number'] == 11 && datum['_iso_week_of_year_number'] == 1, datum['_iso_week_of_year_number'] + 52, datum['_iso_week_of_year_number'] )",
      "as": "_iso_week_of_year_number"
    },
    // select the appropriate week number
    {
      "calculate": "if( datum['_week_start_day'] == 'monday', datum['_iso_week_of_year_number'], datum['_week_of_year_number'] )",
      "as": "_week_of_year_number"
    },
    // calculate the week-of-month number
    {
      "window": [
        {
          "op": "dense_rank",
          "as": "_week_of_month_number"
        }
      ],
      "groupby": [
        "_month"
      ],
      "sort": [
        {
          "field": "_week_of_year_number",
          "order": "ascending"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "calculate": "_quarter_prefix + datum['_quarter_number'] + _quarter_suffix",
      "as": "_quarter_name"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "datum['_month_number'] - ( datum['_quarter_number'] - 1 ) * 3",
      "as": "_month_of_quarter_number"
    },
    // extract the month and day-of-week name from their arrays
    {
      "calculate": "_month_name_array[datum['_month_number']]",
      "as": "_month_name"
    },
    {
      "calculate": "_day_of_week_name2_array[datum['_day_of_week_number']]",
      "as": "_day_of_week_name_name2"
    },
    // compose composite label for X axis for day of week number and initial
    {
      "calculate": "if( datum['_week_start_day'] == 'monday', datum['_iso_day_of_week_number'], datum['_day_of_week_number'] ) + '-' + datum['_day_of_week_name_name2']",
      "as": "_day_of_week_number_and_name2_label"
    },
    // select the appropriate metric
    {
      "calculate": "if( datum['_metric'] == 'count', datum['_daily_transactions'], datum['_daily_value'] )",
      "as": "_daily_metric"
    },
    // calculate the metric percent of the max metric
    {
      "joinaggregate": [
        {
          "op": "max",
          "field": "_daily_metric",
          "as": "_max_daily_metric"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "calculate": "round( 100 * datum['_daily_metric'] / datum['_max_daily_metric'] ) / 100",
      "as": "_daily_metric_percent"
    }
  ],
  "params": [
    // retrieve the desired display language from the Power BI dataset
    {
      "name": "_lang",
      "expr": "lower( slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) )"
    },
    // select the appropriate quarter prefix and suffix
    {
      "name": "_quarter_prefix",
      "expr": "_lang == 'en' ? 'Q' : _lang == 'fr' ? 'T' : _lang == 'es' ? 'T' : _lang == 'de' ? 'Q' : _lang == 'it' ? 'T' : _lang == 'pl' ? '' : _lang == 'nl' ? 'K' : 'Q'"
    },
    {
      "name": "_quarter_suffix",
      "expr": "_lang == 'en' ? '' : _lang == 'fr' ? '' : _lang == 'es' ? '' : _lang == 'de' ? '' : _lang == 'it' ? '' : _lang == 'pl' ? 'kw' : _lang == 'nl' ? '' : null"
    },
    // compose the month name and day-of-week name2 arrays
    {
      "name": "_month_name_array_english",
      "expr": "[ 'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_month_name_array_french",
      "expr": "[ 'Janvier', 'Février', 'Mars', 'Avril', 'Mai', 'Juin', 'Juillet', 'Août', 'Septembre', 'Octobre', 'Novembre', 'Décembre' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_month_name_array_spanish",
      "expr": "[ 'Enero', 'Febrero', 'Marzo', 'Abril', 'Mayo', 'Junio', 'Julio', 'Agosto', 'Septiembre', 'Octubre', 'Noviembre', 'Diciembre' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_month_name_array_german",
      "expr": "[ 'Januar', 'Februar', 'März', 'April', 'Mai', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'August', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Dezember' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_month_name_array_italian",
      "expr": "[ 'Gennaio', 'Febbraio', 'Marzo', 'Aprile', 'Maggio', 'Giugno', 'Luglio', 'Agosto', 'Settembre', 'Ottobre', 'Novembre', 'Dicembre' ]"
    },
    {

    },
    {
      "name": "_month_name_array_dutch",
      "expr": "[ 'januari', 'februari', 'maart', 'april', 'mei', 'juni', 'juli', 'augustus', 'september', 'oktober', 'november', 'december' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_day_of_week_name2_array_english",
      "expr": "[ 'Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_day_of_week_name2_array_french",
      "expr": "[ 'Di', 'Lu', 'Ma', 'Me', 'Je', 'Ve', 'Sa' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_day_of_week_name2_array_spanish",
      "expr": "[ 'Do', 'Lu', 'Ma', 'Mi', 'Ju', 'Vi', 'Sa' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_day_of_week_name2_array_german",
      "expr": "[ 'So', 'Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_day_of_week_name2_array_italian",
      "expr": "[ 'Do', 'Lu', 'Ma', 'Me', 'Gi', 'Ve', 'Sa' ]"
    },
    {
      "name": "_day_of_week_name2_array_polish",
      "expr": "[ 'Ni', 'Po', 'Wt', 'Śr', 'Cz', 'Pi', 'So' ]"
    },

- set [Properties / Tooltips / Options / Sentence template] to "{_day_of_month_number} {_month_name} {_year}: {_daily_metric} ({_daily_metric_percent})"
- set [Properties / Tooltips / Options / Sentence format only] to "on"

NOTE: include all tooltip values to enable them to be passed to Power BI
*/

              "field": "_day_of_month_number",

            },
            {
              "field": "_daily_metric_percent",
              "type": "quantitative",

              "format": "#%"

            "name": "DAILY_RECTANGLE",

                  "resolve": "global",

              "width": 28,
              "height": 28,
              "tooltip": true,
              "style": "_rect_style"

                },
                "value": 4

            "name": "DAY_OF_MONTH",

                "calculate": "_hover._day_of_year_number",

              },
              "color": {
                "expr": "datum['_daily_metric_percent'] <= 0.4 ? 'black' : 'white' "
              },

            "encoding": {
